Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
Hi,

If the Improvised Flamethrower on Mictlantecuhtli is blown by R damage, does Mictlantecuhtli take 2 aggravated damage?

The Talbot's Chainsaw clearly says that "this weapon inflicts" damage, but the Improvised Flamethrower has a different wording, so it's a bit unclear if it counts as a weapon dealing damage.

Warning: Spoiler!

Mictlantecuhtli
Independent: Mictlantecuhtli is immune to damage from weapons. Each of your other ready vampires gains 1 blood after he commits diablerie (before the blood hunt is called). +1 strength.

Improvised Flamethrower
Weapon.
Strike: 2R aggravated damage, only usable once per combat. If the opposing minion inflicts any damage on this minion at long range (even if it is prevented), this weapon is burned and the bearer takes 2 aggravated (non-strike) damage.

Talbot's Chainsaw
Unique weapon.
Strike: 3 damage. If the bearer is ready during your unlock phase, this weapon inflicts 3 unpreventable damage on a ready minion you control. The bearer cannot hunt. The bearer can enter combat with a minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. The bearer gets 1 press (mandatory), only usable to continue combat during the first round, and can prevent 1 damage each combat.

Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body: The damage is still made by the weapon equipment, so he doesn't take the damage

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> acbishop wrote:
> The damage is still made by the weapon equipment, so he doesn't take the damage
>
Correct.
